question: Before winning India’s first Olympic medal in tennis, in which Olympic Games did Leander Paes first participate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barcelona Games**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes**, one of India's greatest tennis players, first participated in the **1992 Barcelona Olympics**. This was his debut in the Olympic Games.
 
• The **Barcelona Olympics** marked a significant milestone for Paes, as it was his first exposure to the global arena of the Olympics, where he represented **India in tennis.**
 
• Leander Paes later won **India's first Olympic medal in tennis** at the **1996 Atlanta Olympics**, where he claimed the **bronze medal** in the men's singles category. *Hence, statement 2 is not correct as it pertains to his medal, not his debut.*
 
• The **1992 Barcelona Games** provided Leander Paes with the opportunity to showcase his talent on a global platform, setting the stage for his future achievements. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• Statements referring to the **2000 Sydney Olympics or the Commonwealth Games** are not relevant to this question, as Paes' first Olympic appearance was in 1992. *Hence, statements 3 and 4 are incorrect.*
 
• Leander Paes' journey in the Olympics began in **Barcelona**, which formed the foundation of his illustrious career and his eventual bronze medal win in Atlanta. *Hence, the correct answer is the Barcelona Games.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes:**

 
 
• **Leander Paes** is an Indian professional tennis player who is renowned for his achievements in both singles and doubles formats. Born on **June 17, 1973**, in Kolkata, India, he became one of the most successful tennis players in Indian history.
 
• He has won numerous **Grand Slam titles** in doubles and mixed doubles and is widely regarded for his longevity and dedication to the sport. Paes' Olympic bronze medal in 1996 remains one of his most celebrated achievements.
 
 
 
• **1992 Barcelona Olympics:**
 
 
• The **1992 Summer Olympics** were held in **Barcelona, Spain**, and featured the participation of athletes from across the globe in various sports.
 
• This event marked **Leander Paes' Olympic debut**, where he represented India in tennis. Though he did not win a medal, it was a significant milestone in his career.
 
 
 
• **1996 Atlanta Olympics:**
 
 
• The **1996 Summer Olympics** were held in **Atlanta, USA**, where Leander Paes won **India's first Olympic medal in tennis** by securing the **bronze medal** in the men's singles event.
 
• This achievement elevated Paes to the status of a national icon and remains a landmark moment in Indian sports history.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Olympic Games Participation:**

 
 
• **Leander Paes** participated in a record **seven Olympic Games** (from 1992 to 2016), showcasing his remarkable consistency and commitment to representing India on the global stage.
 
• He is one of the few athletes in the world to have competed in seven consecutive Olympic events.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Leander Paes:**
 
 
• Leander Paes' achievements, including his **bronze medal at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics**, have inspired generations of Indian athletes and tennis players.
 
• He is widely respected for his contributions to Indian sports and his role in popularizing tennis in the country.
